name: @openclaw/babelfish
description: Use plugins from supported coding and agent apps in OpenClaw

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=bundle --external:@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/* --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/bin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=bundle --external:@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/* --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile=dist/bin.js
